parsed.post: New best! Increased DEPTH to 6 improved val_bpb from 1.0115 to 1.0084. Capacity seems to be a strong lever. Next, I'll test if increasing the learning rate slightly (0.05 -> 0.06) can better leverage the higher depth, or if I should pivot to regularization (WEIGHT_DECAY).
parsed.description: Increasing learning rate slightly to 0.06 to see if the increased capacity from DEPTH=6 can handle a higher learning rate for faster/better convergence.
